text:
michelle: Postmortem follow-up: need a short public blurb, a 72h customer summary, and a clear policy for full-RCA sharing. Also assign remediation owners and tag recurring incidents.

raj: I can draft the public blurb. One paragraph + apology + promise to follow up in 72h.

olivia: I'll own the 72h summary skeleton (timeline, impact metrics, mitigations, recurrence note). I'll add a "what's included" section so customers know what's redacted.

legal-bot: Reminder: any external RCA that includes customer-identifiable data requires Legal review; hostnames, internal IPs, and raw logs should be redacted.

michelle: Let's lock action items here. React with :thumbsup: to accept.

```
AI-9201: Raj      - Draft public status blurb by Wed 12:00 UTC and post to Statuspage draft.
AI-9202: Olivia   - Publish 72h customer summary skeleton to PM-999 by +72h (include recurrence analysis and quick mitigation list).
AI-9203: Legal    - Provide redaction checklist + approval flow by +48h.
AI-9204: Support  - Export impacted-customer list and assign outreach owners by today EOD.
AI-9205: Ops      - Create remediation tickets for recurrence fixes and tag owners for verification by next sprint.
```

support: Accept AI-9204. Uploading affected customer list now.

raj: Draft blurb: "We experienced intermittent API errors between 03:10 and 04:05 UTC due to a database failover. Some requests returned 5xx errors; normal service resumed at 04:05 UTC after rerouting traffic. We apologize for the disruption. A follow-up summary with impact metrics and next steps will be published within 72 hours."

olivia: That looks good. For the 72h doc I'll include a short "included / excluded" block referencing Legal's checklist and two proposed runbook items: circuit-breaker tuning and post-failover health checks.

legal-bot: Confirmed: exclude PII, internal hostnames/IPs, and raw request logs from external summary. Full RCA available on request; Legal will advise on NDA scope.

michelle: Thanks. Raj, post the blurb to the Statuspage draft and ping @olivia for inclusion link. Olivia, drop the 72h skeleton in PM-999 and tag "recurrence" so Ops picks it up. Support, notify Dedicated customers proactively and attach the 72h summary when ready.

raj: Posting now.

support: Impacted list uploaded and owners assigned.

olivia: 72h skeleton uploaded to PM-999; includes timeline, impact numbers, mitigation steps, recurrence analysis, and the two proposed runbook changes. Will update per Legal checklist before publishing.

michelle: Closing loop: I'll check PM-999 tomorrow and confirm approvals. If anyone needs to shift ETA, call it out here.

raj: :thumbsup:
